name: East African Cables Plc
source: East African Cables Plc audited full year results for the year ended 31 December 2023 | Earnings per share rescaled from the East African Cables Plc full year results for the year ended 31 December 2023, NSE filing library. The filing prints Basic and diluted earnings per share of KShs (0.81) for FY2023 and (1.02) for FY2022; the stored row carried (810) and (1020), the same figures a thousand times too large. | CRON 20260929_003746: Income Tax sign normalised to the dataset convention, the charge stored positive and a credit negative, on 2 period(s), so that the rendered Profit Before Tax less Income Tax equals Net Profit. The required sign is fixed by the direction of the move from Profit Before Tax to Net Profit in the stored rows, and the stored magnitude already agreed with that move. | CRON 20261002: Operating Expenses filled from the printed expense components.

rows.source: Operating expenses summed from the printed components of the East African Cables Plc audited results for the year ended 31 December 2023: factory expenses plus administrative expenses plus selling and distribution expenses. FY2023 710,699 = 152,740 + 459,413 + 98,546. FY2022 466,393 = 153,806 + 231,349 + 81,238. Ties to the printed (Loss)/Profit before Depreciation, Impairment and Finance Costs of (19,722) and 229,015: gross profit plus other income less operating expenses.
